notes.title: Demo Update Live!
notes.content:
Thanks to your feedback we've made a number of significant updates to the demo, including adding Spanish VO, keybind customization, and more! 

Spanish voices and text localization added

Weapon damage rebalanced

Keyboard key binding support implemented

New special death animations

Resolution issues above Full HD fixed

DLSS temporarily disabled due to performance problems

New tutorials added

Various bugs fixed

notes.title: Demo OUT NOW
notes.content:
Crisol demo now available

[previewyoutube="wk--ShC5Pds;full"][/previewyoutube]
We are so excited to finally share the demo for Crisol: Theater of Idols with you! This demo is a small portion of an early chapter in the game, giving you a glimpse at the combat, blood reload mechanic, an alternate weapon that you can find, and a few other secrets that we can't wait to discuss. The horrors of Tormentosa await... 



PLAY NOW
